name: Bermuda
prevalence_note: The Government of Bermuda has warned about a fraudulent WhatsApp message posing as the Bermuda Post Office and keeps a page on avoiding and reporting scams; police and the bankers' association have run joint scam warnings.
cross_border_note: Bermuda (+1-441) uses NANP numbering, so spoofed +1 calls and overseas WhatsApp numbers can pass for local contacts.

scams.name: Fake Bermuda Post Office WhatsApp
scams.name_en: WhatsApp message posing as Bermuda Post Office demanding customs duty via a link
scams.signals_en: A WhatsApp message claims the Bermuda Post Office is holding a parcel until duty is paid through a link.
scams.legit_en: The Government of Bermuda has flagged this WhatsApp message as fraudulent; check only with the Post Office directly.
bait_tactics: Ask which Bermuda post office branch holds it and repeat the branch name back
Say duty is only ever paid at the counter in person
